svg.aria-label: odin failover: engine-2 is killed, engines 1 and 3 take its 21 shards, no run is lost and none is charged twice
svg.text: odin: kill an engine mid-run, lose nothing
3 engines, 64 shards, one writer per shard, each on a 10-second lease
engine-2 is killed mid-run; its leases are left to run out
engines 1 and 3 take its 21 shards; fencing stops any stale write
writing again in about 9.5 s; the checker finds 0 runs lost, 0 charged twice
